description: alg A256GCM, a content encryption name, is refused with UnsupportedAlgorithm even when a member's alg is A256GCM; decided by ADR 0054 §1.1: A256GCM is an enc name (RFC 7518 §5.1), neither a JWS nor a key management alg, so the alg setter refuses it; a dir key is selected with alg dir (§2.2); outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
